subject: Nimbus Health - weekly fleet planning / pilot sizing
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Eli Torres <eli.torres@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Nimbus Health - initial fleet sizing ask for upcoming pilot

Team — looping infra and finance so we can align on a recommended dedicated footprint for the Nimbus pilot next month. Eli from Nimbus is copying expected query patterns and an initial NRR ask (see attachment). High level:
- 3-week pilot, expected concurrent sessions ~40, peak prompt length ~1.5k tokens, average infer size ~500 tokens per request
- They want a reserved pool for predictable latency; are open to a short reserve + burst model

Ask: can infra/finance propose a sizing (GPU count / memory profile) and a rough 2-tier pricing sketch (pilot vs. committed 2yr) by EOD Thu so we can include it in the MAP for Nimbus?

Attachments: Nimbus_Pilot_MVP_workload_profiles.csv

Thanks,
Vanessa
Sr. Account Exec — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Eli Torres <eli.torres@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nimbus Health - initial fleet sizing ask for upcoming pilot

Vanessa — quick read through the workload csv. A few notes from infra ops:
- For 40 concurrent sessions at ~500 tokens avg, continuous batching is critical. We should plan for a baseline of 4x A100s (40GB) with a KV-cache-enabled serving profile to hit the 90ms p95 target.
- If they expect burst concurrency beyond 80, add 2 additional cards for headroom.

Finance: rough committed discount math attached as a placeholder (Marcus?), but architecturally this looks like a small dedicated pod that could be shared across pilots in Q1. I'll add a note on quantization path if they want a cheaper option.

K

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Eli Torres <eli.torres@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nimbus Health - initial fleet sizing ask for upcoming pilot

Vanessa / Karthik — attaching a quick sketch: Nimbus_2yr_commit_estimate.xlsx. Two scenarios:
1) Pilot (3-weeks reserved + burst): 4x A100-40GB baseline, autoscale 0->2 gpus for bursts. Estimated pilot cost: $18k (includes pre-warm buffer).
2) 2yr modest commit (predictable throughput): 6x A100-40GB with lower committed per-token pricing. Estimated committed run-rate: $9k/month effective after discount.

Notes: these are first-pass. We need to confirm their request pattern (steady vs. spiky), retention requirements (KV cache TTLs), and whether model variant can be a quantized 4-bit to bring down GPU memory footprint.

Attachments: Nimbus_2yr_commit_estimate.xlsx

Marcus
Head of Finance — Provisioning & Pricing

From: Eli Torres <eli.torres@nimbushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nimbus Health - initial fleet sizing ask for upcoming pilot

Hi Vanessa + team — thanks for the quick turn. A couple clarifications from our side: 
- The 40 concurrent estimate is conservative; we expect a ramp from 10 -> 50 over the 3-week pilot as we onboard clinics.
- Latency SLAs: our clinicians need sub-200ms p95 on short prompts; for longer notes (>1k tokens) 400ms p95 is acceptable.
- Security: we need to confirm SOC2 evidence and audit logs for the pilot.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow to lock down assumptions. Shared a procurement contact on this thread — they will start the paperwork if costs look reasonable.

Best,
Eli
Head of Integrations — Nimbus Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Eli Torres <eli.torres@nimbushealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nimbus Health - initial fleet sizing ask for upcoming pilot

Eli — thanks, and welcome. Quick summary after internal sync: action items and final proposal for the MAP:

1) Infrastructure recommendation
- Pilot: 4x A100-40GB dedicated baseline with 2x burst GPUs (pre-warmed). KV cache enabled, batch size target 32, p95 target for short prompts ~180ms.
- Committed (2yr): 6x A100-40GB with quantization path for 4-bit variant; we can commit to model pinning windows to avoid regression risk.

2) Security/compliance
- We will share SOC2 in the next 24 hours and provide audit-log ingestion instructions for the pilot. (See fleet-sizing-runbook.pdf)

3) Pricing & commercial next steps
- Marcus: finalizes the two-line pricing grid and sends a formal quote + DocuSign by EOD Friday.
- Vanessa: will schedule a 30-min alignment call tomorrow with Eli + procurement to confirm ramp assumptions.

Attachments: fleet-sizing-runbook.pdf

Laura Bennett
Director, Fleet Operations — Redwood Inference
